caveat: witnesses are derived from componentType NAMES, not from file contents; an absent witness means the vocabulary cannot say, never that the mode did not occur
reason_rule: implied modes = union of witnesses of the record's ada:componentType values
field is N in EVERY implied mode -> inapplicable
anything else, including a mixed answer -> unknown
inapplicable is a positive claim and needs unanimity; unknown is the safe default
source: the TAPP workbooks' mode-flag columns, via build_tapp.mode_columns()
